description: This file defines the Ods class responsible for writing PhpSpreadsheet objects into ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet) format. It manages various components such as metadata, styles, content, and thumbnails, and handles the process of packaging the spreadsheet data into a zipped ODS file.

classes.name: Ods
classes.description: A class responsible for writing a PhpSpreadsheet object into an ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet) file, managing different parts of the file structure and the packaging process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Ods writer with a given Spreadsheet object and creates components for content, meta, meta information, mimetype, settings, styles, and thumbnails.

methods.name: getWriterPartContent
methods.description: Returns the Content part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: getWriterPartMeta
methods.description: Returns the Meta part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: getWriterPartMetaInf
methods.description: Returns the MetaInf part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: getWriterPartMimetype
methods.description: Returns the Mimetype part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: getWriterPartSettings
methods.description: Returns the Settings part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: getWriterPartStyles
methods.description: Returns the Styles part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: getWriterPartThumbnails
methods.description: Returns the Thumbnails part handler for the ODS file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Spreadsheet as an ODS file to the specified filename or resource. It processes flags, manages the ZIP archive creation, adds necessary parts, and handles exceptions during finalization.

methods.name: createZip
methods.description: Creates and returns a ZipStream object for packaging the ODS file contents.

methods.name: getSpreadsheet
methods.description: Returns the Spreadsheet object associated with this writer.

methods.name: setSpreadsheet
methods.description: Sets the Spreadsheet object for this writer.
